message.content:
Although an Leshy, Pebble Spring became immediately fascinated by the mortal settlements when they set foot in a city.
They loves the nicely paved ground, the intricate bridges, and the most of all, they loved houses.
The nicely layed out stone walls forming shelters from the weathers yet connect the earth with the stories from every family.
They decided to learn the craft of housebuilding with the help of a touch of arcane magic from their self-made staff.
They watched masons shape each stone.
They watched carpenters fit each beam.
They watched smiths set each hinge.
They watched bakers warm each hearth.
They practiced laying flat foundation stones.
They practiced raising straight corner posts.
They practiced framing simple doorways.
They practiced roofing with overlapping shingles.
Their first wall leaned slightly to the left.
Their first roof leaked when the rain began.
Their first door stuck in its frame.
Their first path cracked after one storm.
They laughed at the clumsy result.
They promised to try again.
Pebble Spring studied the old city plans.
Pebble Spring traced the old city seams.
Pebble Spring tested the old city stones.
Pebble Spring measured the old city gaps.
Pebble Spring prepared a fresh start.
Pebble Spring examined the city and noted that its street, bridge, wall, door, roof, beam, sill, step, path, gate, arch, lintel, post, rail, tile, curb, seam, joint, nail, chisel, level, square, cord, trowel looked spotty now.
